title: Week 5 — Baker National
body:
📣 BAKER NATIONAL (Week 5) — All rounds complete! (front + back 9 combined — Summer's underway)

Skins — 6 total, $16.67 each:
    •    Front 9: Simpson (deuce on the par-3 2nd), Archer ×2 (net 3 on 5, net 2.5 on 8)
    •    Back 9: Anderson (net 2 on 11), Mugford (deuce on the par-3 15th), Nelson (net 3.5 on 17)

TOTW: Leadley/Mullins — Net 69 ($50). Their third TOTW of the year. 😳

Low team gross: 80, Oakman/Simpson
High team net: 95, Bower/Petrovskis

🪓 Beatdown of the Season: Mugford 9.5–0.5 over Petrovskis — the most lopsided match anyone has posted all year, and a single conceded half-point away from a perfect 10–0 card. You cannot win by more.
Runner-up rompings: Hopkins 8–2 over Bower and Mullins 8–2 over Heinsch made it a big day for the favorites.

Low gross round: 37, Archer
Low net round: 33.5, Simpson

⚔️ Streak Breaker: Anderson had the low gross round at every course this season... until now. Archer's 37 edged Anderson's 38 by a single stroke to end the reign. By ONE.

🧹 Clean Sweep: Oakman/Simpson took down Gallagher/Fischer with both partners winning, plus the low team gross (80). A tidy afternoon.

Hardest hole: Hole 18 (Par 4, 389 yds) played a brutal +2.25 over par — the closing hole bared its teeth
Easiest hole: Hole 4 (Par 5, 475 yds) played EXACTLY even par — the field feasted on the reachable par 5

🎉 The Fist Pump Heard 'Round the World: Down 8–2 to Hopkins and standing on the hardest hole on the course, Pat Bower rolled in a 10-footer for a double-bogey 6 to halve the 18th — and unleashed a fist pump for the ages. Never let the scoreboard dim the celebration. We salute you, Pat.

Full scorecards + standings: hankhopkins.github.io/sagl
